SCHTEACH.TITLE: Medicine Rotation II
SCHTEACH.PEDINN: A number of new learning techniques were employed to keep the clinical student engaged and continuing their learning process for this course during COVID lockdown.  Enhanced learning objective were given to the student to study, including a PowerPoint presentation on a specific learning objective for the end of rotation exam.   Case studies were presented by the students based on the assignment and weekly online classes were conducted where the students would interact with their cohort to discuss case studies.

SCHTEACH.TITLE: Patient Encounter II
SCHTEACH.TECHMAT: More video material was incorporated into the modules for the students to review the methods of how to conduct a physical exam.  The lab was held in person with strict COVID guidelines enforced where the instructor could monitor their technique and answer any questions about the physical exam.   In addition, the students were required to video a summative physical exam each week for evaluation by the instructors and feedback was given to each student.

SCHTEACH.TITLE: Electrocardiography Seminar
SCHTEACH.TECHMAT: This fall I introduced a new textbook for the ECG course which is more clinically oriented.  This gives the student more clinical insight about how to use the ECG in making clinical decisions.  Also I redesigned the course to be online using Modules to present the materials and modular exam to make sure they have mastered the concepts within that specific module.  A post test class was held to answer any concerns.

SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.DESC: Review CASPA applications for Candidates for the Physician Assistant program.  Conduct interviews in the multiple mini interview format.
SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.ACCOMPLISH: As a committee we recieved over 1300 applications thru CASPA and evaluated 900.  We conducted 300 interviews and selected the up comming class of 100 Physician Assistant students.

SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.DESC: Attend Graduate workshops to inform students of the Physician Assistant program.  Attend local high school career day to inform the students of the Physician Assistant profession and out program here in the Rio Grande Valley.
SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.ACCOMPLISH: Attended Several Graduate workshop at both Edinburg and Brownsville campus.  Attended HESTEC with a demonstration of our lab simulator SAMII

SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.DESC: Reviewing student applications and ranking candidates for possible admission into the Physician Assistant program.  Also hold informational sessions (open houses) for prospective applicants.  Finally select the best qualified candidates for acceptance into the Physician Assistant program.
SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.ACCOMPLISH: Revamped our interview format to a Multiple Mini Interview for its inaugural cycle in the Fall.  Reviewed over 900 applications, interviewed over 300 applicants and admitted 80 candidates into the upcomming class in Fall 2019.

SERVICE_DEPARTMENT.ACCOMPLISH: So far this year we have awarded $32,000 to students
